name: Community — Qwen Image 2.1
author: michaeldune
description: Qwen-Image 2.1, the 7B model that writes, edits and cuts out in one: text-to-image with accurate lettering, editing from up to four reference pictures, and background removal to a real transparent PNG. About 16 seconds for a 1024 px picture on a 12 GB card. One 17 GB download covers all three cards.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1
presets.tagline: Fast text-to-image with lettering that spells
presets.description: Text-to-image with Qwen-Image 2.1. Follows long natural-language prompts and renders quoted text on signs, labels and posters correctly. For a transparent result, start the prompt with: This is an RGBA image with transparency. and end it with: The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs a ComfyUI build that contains core commit 6bfaacc67 (Qwen-Image 2.1 support, 2026-09-19). Tested 2026-09-20 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (stock ComfyUI master): 16 s per 1024x1024 or 1344x768 picture at 25 steps, about 9.4 GB VRAM in use; a five-word shop sign came out letter-perfect; the RGBA prompt produced real alpha.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Edit
presets.tagline: Edit or combine up to four pictures by describing the change
presets.description: Describe the edit in plain words and refer to the pictures by position: Keep the woman in <image1> unchanged, put the jacket from <image2> on her. One to four reference pictures; each extra one adds time (about 20 s for one, 50 s for two, 105 s for four on a 12 GB card). The result uses the aspect ratio you pick, so choose the one that matches your first picture when the framing should stay the same.

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs a ComfyUI build that contains core commit 6bfaacc67 (Qwen-Image 2.1 support, 2026-09-19). One text encoder node per reference count behind lazy If/Else switches, so empty slots cost nothing. References are resized to about 1 MP before encoding (the node's resolution input). Every extra reference lengthens the sequence: on a 4070 Ti 12 GB one reference took 22 s, two took 52 s and four took 106 s at 25 steps (2026-09-20, stock ComfyUI master); identity, a sticker character, a lettered sign and a street scene all carried into one four-reference picture.

presets.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Cutout
presets.tagline: Remove the background, get a transparent PNG
presets.description: One picture in, the subject out on a transparent background, hair and soft edges included. The instruction is built in; use the prompt box only to say what to keep (for example: keep the microphone and the cable). The result always has the size and shape of your picture; the aspect ratio setting is ignored.

extensions.name: rgthree-comfy
extensions.description: Power Lora Loader, used by SimpliGen's own LoRA slot. Usually pre-installed.

requirements.notes: All three cards share one set of weights from Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1: the int8 ConvRot model (7.3 GB), the int8 ConvRot Qwen3-VL 8B text encoder (9.4 GB) and the 2.1 VAE (0.7 GB). Official template settings: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler/simple. Needs a ComfyUI build that contains core commit 6bfaacc67 (Qwen-Image 2.1 support, 2026-09-19). Samples on the latent the encoder returns for the reference, so the cut-out lines up with the source pixel for pixel (rounded to a multiple of 32, about 1 MP). The brief is the model card's own (Remove the background, and output a PNG image) plus a keep-the-whole-subject sentence, with {{prompt}} appended as extra notes. The bare model-card line followed by an empty prompt deleted the subject's jacket and hair on 1 of 3 seeds; with the keep sentence 18 of 18 portrait renders were identical in coverage. Card template tested on a portrait, a B&W profile, a sneaker on a cluttered bench and a long-haired dog, two seeds each: 8 of 8 clean, 16-22 s. A picture with no clear subject (a street scene) comes back mostly or fully transparent.
